Intervals are conditional on these two persistent worker processes.
Alternating adjacent pairs limits drift but does not remove all thermal, scheduler, cache or background-load effects.
Block length 5 covers short serial dependence; longer dependence or another host may yield different uncertainty.
Intervals are per case, without simultaneous coverage adjustment.
